name: Salsa Verde Food Truck
about: A taco stop on West Broad Street in Falls Church. Customers come for Mexican-style street tacos and return for the flavor, friendly service, and a satisfying lunch break.
address: 400 W Broad St, Falls Church, VA 22046

reviews.author: Shaun D.
reviews.text: I ordered one of each of the chicken pork and steak soft tacos. They all were delicious and the service was great.

reviews.author: Jon L.
reviews.text: This taco truck is legit. Real Mexican-style street tacos on corn tortillas.

reviews.author: Amber D.
reviews.text: I stopped here on my lunch break. Best decision ever the food was so amazing. I will definitely be back soon.
